entries.title: Tests

entries.title: Init Functions as Command Core + Skill Shell
entries.summary: Mechanical init steps extracted into deterministic Python scripts; skills become interactive wrappers that call commands. Backstopped by verify-foundations.

entries.title: Remove sdd-plus-superpowers custom schema
entries.summary: Replaced the custom sdd-plus-superpowers OpenSpec schema with the package-provided spec-driven schema. Workflow complexity (small/medium/large) is now handled by the sdlc-orchestrator skill via interaction flow (direct, propose, incremental) instead of custom schema variation.

entries.title: Canonical-First Skill Updates with Multi-CLI Distribution
entries.summary: Skills under skills/ are canonical source of truth. Changes must be made there first, then distributed to project-level and user-level CLI targets.

entries.title: Separate target eval model from grader model in Promptfoo config
entries.summary: The target model (deepseek-v4-pro) and the llm-rubric grader model (glm-5.1) are configured independently in model-matrix.yaml, driven by separate `promptfoo` and `grader` blocks. This avoids JSON extraction failures when reasoning models are used as graders.

entries.title: Template Sync + Canonical Distribution Workflow
entries.summary: Live .ai/workflows/ files sync to canonical skills/ templates; git hook enforces consistency; distributed copies derived from canonical.

entries.title: opencode-go OpenAI-compatible provider fails with TypeError terminated without Accept-Encoding identity
entries.summary: Promptfoo's built-in openai:chat provider throws `TypeError: terminated` in 2-4 seconds when calling opencode-go endpoint if `Accept-Encoding: identity` is not set in provider config headers.

entries.title: after-dispatch can preserve stale phase evidence or fake progress when worker contracts are inconsistent
DeepSeek V4 Pro causes llm-rubric JSON extraction failures
entries.summary: Reasoning models like deepseek-v4-pro put output in `reasoning_content` instead of `content`, causing Promptfoo llm-rubric to fail with "Could not extract JSON from llm-rubric response".

entries.title: EvalOps golden case expected.rubric is the Promptfoo assertion value — evaluators.llm_judge.rubric is ignored by export
Exact phrase contains assertions are brittle for LLM outputs
entries.summary: Deterministic `contains` assertions like `"OpenSpec proposal"` fail when the model uses semantically equivalent but lexically different terms (e.g. "OpenSpec change", "OpenSpec artifacts").

entries.title: Live .ai/workflows/ Files Drift from Skill Templates
entries.summary: Editing only .ai/workflows/scripts/workflow.py without syncing to sdlc-project-bootstrap/templates/ causes new bootstrapped projects to get stale template files. Pre-commit hook now enforces sync.

entries.title: Low max_tokens causes output truncation for reasoning models
entries.summary: DeepSeek V4 Pro consumes reasoning tokens from the max_tokens budget, leaving insufficient quota for content. With max_tokens=2000, outputs can be truncated to as few as 136 characters.

entries.title: roadmap_done_if_relevant hook recreates active run after self-finalization, causing governance-check infinite loop
Distributed Skill Copies Drift from Canonical
entries.summary: Editing `.opencode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` without syncing to `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (canonical) or other distributed copies breaks canonical-distributed symmetry and causes test failures.

entries.title: Stale global skill copies bypass OpenSpec init guardrails
entries.summary: If global CLI skill copies are stale, bootstrap/init may run old non-interactive OpenSpec commands and skip config.yaml persistence despite updated repo-local skills.

entries.title: OpenSpec bootstrap and init skill contract
entries.summary: Defines and verifies project bootstrap orchestration and OpenSpec init behavior, including pre-init tool selection, schema recommendation, partial init recovery, and strict summary contract.

entries.title: 2026-06-21 — Workflow Runtime Enhancements
entries.summary: Added verify-foundations command, --json flag, sync_templates.py (canonical protection), init_foundations.py (command-backed init), git pre-commit hook, and multi-CLI distribution enforcement.

entries.title: 2026-07-02 - Roadmap Hook Governance Hardening
entries.summary: Hardened workflow roadmap hook governance by adding roadmap-agent lifecycle routing, validating ready/apply-start hook state at complete-hook time, fixing after-dispatch stale evidence promotion, and enforcing template/distribution sync.

entries.title: Workflow Runtime Modularization — sibling package behind script facade
entries.summary: Split monolithic workflow.py into a sibling workflow_runtime/ package while keeping workflow.py as the executable CLI facade. Modules follow a strict dependency direction; state writes confined to state.py.

entries.title: Workflow Runtime Module Architecture
entries.summary: workflow_runtime/ package behind a thin workflow.py CLI facade. Modules: core, state, definitions, domains, policies, dispatch, lifecycle, governance, cli. state.py is sole run-state writer; domains.py is read-only.
